title: Compare before committing
user_input: Find a refundable hotel for two people next Friday.
assistant_output: Ask for the destination and budget if missing, inspect current provider/browser options, and compare total prices and refund deadlines. Do not submit a reservation.

title: Ambiguous checkout
user_input: The checkout page timed out. Try again.
